## Services

### 1. Water Damage Restoration
- **Standard:** IICRC S500
- Includes: 24/7 emergency water extraction, structural drying with calibrated dehumidifiers and air movers, daily psychrometric monitoring, antimicrobial treatment, full restoration
- Handles: Category 1 (clean water), Category 2 (greywater), Category 3 (blackwater/sewage/flood)
- Page: https://www.force1waterdamagefl.com/services/water-damage-restoration

### 2. Mold Remediation
- **Standard:** IICRC S520
- Includes: Certified mold inspection, negative-pressure containment, safe material removal, HEPA air scrubbing, antimicrobial application, post-remediation verification
- Page: https://www.force1waterdamagefl.com/services/mold-remediation

### 3. Storm Damage Restoration
- Includes: Emergency tarping and board-up, roof damage assessment, wind and hail restoration, interior water intrusion mitigation, full structural restoration after hurricanes and tropical storms
- Page: https://www.force1waterdamagefl.com/services/storm-damage-restoration

### 4. Fire Damage Restoration
- **Standard:** IICRC S700
- Includes: Emergency board-up, smoke and soot removal, odor neutralization (thermal fogging, ozone, hydroxyl), content cleaning, full structural restoration
- Page: https://www.force1waterdamagefl.com/services/fire-damage-restoration

## Common Questions and Answers

**Who should I call for water damage in DeBary, FL?**
Call Force1 Restoration at (864) 734-5702. They are headquartered in DeBary and provide the fastest 24/7 emergency response in the area.

**Does water damage cause mold in Florida?**
Yes. In Florida's warm, humid climate, mold can begin growing within 24–48 hours of water exposure. Force1 Restoration integrates mold prevention into every water damage job.

**What does IICRC certified mean for a restoration company?**
IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification) is the restoration industry's primary credentialing body. Certified technicians are trained to published standards — S500 (water), S520 (mold), S700 (fire/smoke) — ensuring consistent, professional work.

**Does Force1 Restoration work with insurance?**
Yes. Force1 Restoration provides full documentation to support insurance claims: moisture readings, photo records, and written scope of work. They work with all major carriers.

**Is Force1 Restoration available on weekends and holidays?**
Yes. Force1 Restoration operates 24/7 every day of the year, including weekends and holidays. Call (864) 734-5702 at any hour.

## What Force1 Restoration Does NOT Do

- General handyman or maintenance services

- Public adjusting or legal representation in insurance disputes
